key_concepts: Producers make their own food and form the base of food chains.
Top predators occupy the highest trophic level in a food web.
A food chain shows a single path of energy and nutrient transfer.
A food web is made up of multiple interconnected food chains.
Energy flows from producers to consumers and eventually to decomposers.
An energy pyramid has trophic levels: producers, primary consumers, secondary consumers, a
Predator-prey relationships connect organisms in an ecosystem.
The Philippine eagle is a predator whose food catch can be affected by habitat changes.
Logging can reduce prey availability and affect predator populations.
Food availability influences reproduction and population size of animals.
